why-me.title: Why me
why-me.self: I am just starting my journey as a developer – driven by a passion for technology, creative problem solving, and clean code. With strengths such as analytical thinking, perseverance, and teamwork, I quickly adapt to new challenges. I look forward to applying my knowledge in real projects and developing user-friendly applications as part of a team.

mySkills.title: My Skills
mySkills.currentlyLearning: I'm currently deepening my skills in Angular, TypeScript, and JavaScript to build more advanced and scalable frontend applications.

myProjects.title: My Projects
myProjects.description1: A simple jump-and-run game based on object-oriented programming. Help Pepe find coins and chilis to fight small chickens and finally the giant monster chicken.
myProjects.workProcess: How I organized my work process
myProjects.workProcessText: How do you keep your code clean and maintainable? Did you split the project into reusable modules or components? Focus on documentation, naming files, variables, classes, and tests.
myProjects.whatILearntText: As someone who always wants to learn new technologies, I particularly enjoyed this project because I was able to dive deep into a specific technology. Mention details like framework or language.
myProjects.description2: A modern Kanban-style task management application built with Angular and Firebase. Join helps teams organize, assign, and track tasks in real-time using drag & drop functionality and responsive design.
myProjects.workProcessText2: I structured the project into reusable Angular components and services. Clear file and folder naming conventions, TypeScript interfaces, and SCSS modules ensured scalability and maintainability. Firebase was used for backend services like authentication and real-time data handling.
myProjects.whatILearntText2: I deepened my understanding of Angular 19 and TypeScript 5, especially reactive forms, routing, and animations. Working with Firebase taught me about authentication, Firestore database structure, and deploying modern web apps with real-time features.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText1: We have written this privacy policy (version 17.06.2025-323015563) to explain to you in accordance with the requirements of the
privacy.introText2: and applicable national laws, which personal data we as controllers – and the processors commissioned by us (e.g. providers) – process, will process in the future and what lawful options you have.
privacy.introText3: Privacy policies usually sound very technical and use legal jargon. This privacy policy, on the other hand, is intended to describe the most important things to you as simply and transparently as possible. Insofar as it is conducive to transparency, technical terms are explained in a reader-friendly way, links to further information are provided and graphics are used. We thus inform in clear and simple language that we only process personal data in the course of our business activities if there is a corresponding legal basis.
privacy.scopeText: This privacy policy applies to all personal data processed by us in the company and to all personal data processed by companies commissioned by us (processors). By personal data we mean information within the meaning of Article 4 No. 1 GDPR such as name, email address and postal address of a person.
privacy.scopeItem1: all online presences (websites, online shops) that we operate
privacy.scopeItem2: Social media presences and email communication
privacy.scopeItem3: mobile apps for smartphones and other devices
privacy.legalBasisText: In the following privacy policy, we provide you with transparent information about the legal principles and regulations, i.e. the legal bases of the General Data Protection Regulation, that enable us to process personal data.
privacy.consentText: (Article 6 paragraph 1 lit. a GDPR): You have given us your consent to process data for a specific purpose.
privacy.contractText: (Article 6 paragraph 1 lit. b GDPR): To fulfill a contract or pre-contractual obligations with you, we process your data.
privacy.legalObligationText: (Article 6 paragraph 1 lit. c GDPR): If we are subject to a legal obligation, we process your data.
privacy.legitimateInterestsText: (Article 6 paragraph 1 lit. f GDPR): In the case of legitimate interests that do not restrict your fundamental rights, we reserve the right to process personal data.
privacy.storageDurationText: We only store personal data for as long as it is absolutely necessary for the provision of our services and products. This means that we delete personal data as soon as the reason for data processing no longer exists.
